sources.field_scope: Program page. Outfitter guide is a person guiding for compensation on land or water the person does not own. 2026 fees stated on the page: outfitter guide $350, charter guide $500, crew member $50. On this page a charter guide is an outfitter guide with a Coast Guard operator license on navigable water. Charter vessel is defined here as a Coast Guard-inspected vessel carrying 7 or more passengers for hire besides the crew. A 6-pack is described as a guide vessel. Vessel registration fees stated here: $50 a year for an Oregon-registered boat and $100 a year for a documented vessel. ORS chapter 704 and OAR 250 division 15 were opened separately. ORS chapter 830 was linked and not opened. A verification telephone and a program email were not copied.

sources.field_scope: ORS chapter 704, Outfitters and Guides. Section 704.010 defines a charter guide as an outfitter and guide who has a Coast Guard operator license and carries no more than six passengers for hire on federally navigable water. An outfitter and guide is a person who provides or advertises those services for compensation, or who holds a federal special-use permit for them. Employees who conduct angling or operate a boat used for angling are not excluded from the definition. A crew member assists angling or boat operation aboard a boat under direct supervision and is registered with the board. The definition section's history line cites Oregon Laws 2025, chapter 350, section 1. The chapter points a charter boat license at ORS 830.430 to 830.465. That chapter was not opened.

OAR chapter 250, division 15, Ocean Charter Vessels. Rule 250-015-0002 applies the division to charter boats carrying passengers for hire on waters of this state. Rule 250-015-0004, amended effective 2022-10-06, allows a charter boat license for a boat carrying fewer than seven passengers for hire for angling, sightseeing, or other recreational purposes, if the owner completes the application and satisfies 250-015-0035(5). Subsection (5) is a pre-departure safety announcement. Rule 250-015-0005 says the issued license identifies the applicant, the boat, sole-state-waters or within-20-miles operation, and the expiration. It does not say the license prints a vessel name.
